title: Valorization of tannery fleshing waste into high energy biofuel through pyrolysis: process optimization and fuel properties analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,21601-21612
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10133F, Paper

Fleshing waste, a major hazardous by-product of the leather industry, is transformed into high energy biofuel via pyrolysis; RSM optimization delivers 55% yield, with advanced analyses confirming superior fuel quality.
